youtube_title: Always Chewing Ice? This Is A Body Signal | Body Fix #4 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #4. Drink's over... and you start CRUNCHING the ice cubes? Every day?
B is right. A constant urge to chew ice is linked to LOW IRON.
Always tired, pale, breathless on stairs? Also low iron signs.
Fix: Get a blood test. Dal, spinach + vitamin C. And chewing ice can crack teeth.
Red flags: Daily tiredness, breathlessness or heavy periods? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Mayo Clinic / NIH - pica & iron deficiency
